concept: European Doors & Windows (charming facades, ornate doorways, flower-box windows, and entryways from across Europe)
cover_prompt: Full-color illustration of a charming European street scene featuring iconic doors and windows in a warm, inviting travel aesthetic. SQUARE format (1:1 aspect ratio). A narrow cobblestone alley in a Mediterranean village with colorful facades on both sides. The centerpiece is a grand arched wooden door with ornate iron hinges and a brass knocker, flanked by tall shuttered windows with cascading flower boxes overflowing with geraniums and petunias in vivid reds, pinks, and purples. Above the door, a wrought iron balcony with more flowering plants. Neighboring buildings display a variety of beautiful windows: Venetian Gothic arched windows, French shuttered casements in robin's egg blue, and a round porthole window with iron grillwork. Climbing bougainvillea in magenta drapes over the stone walls. Warm terracotta, ochre yellow, dusty rose, sage green, and cerulean blue color palette. A vintage street lantern casts a warm golden glow. Cobblestones glisten softly. Rich detailed illustrated book cover aesthetic, warm European travel atmosphere, premium quality. DO NOT include any text, titles, or words in the image.
